_provenance.compiled_by: Andre Shportko (compilation only, no new research)
_provenance.purpose: Single source of truth for cross-branch TempBench compilation. Every number in the meta-report is sourced from this file.

synthetic_three_arch.setup: n_features=40, d_model=80, d_sae=80, pi=0.15; matched window-L0=k*T

synthetic_andre_v2_toy.setup: NUM_FEATS=128, HIDDEN_DIM=256, T in {2,5}, k in {2,5,10,25}, 65k steps
synthetic_andre_v2_toy.verdict: TXC dominates rho>0 with low/moderate k. IID hurts; high k hurts.

sparse_probing_aniket_saebench.verdict: MLC > TempXC ≈ SAE on this 8-task SAEBench. TempXC degrades monotonically in T; partly attributable to undertraining.

sparse_probing_han_T8.verdict: TXC bare-antidead at T=5 ties MLC at the top of the canonical leaderboard. T>5 hill-climbed variants at matched per-token sparsity (k_pos=20) lose 0.01-0.025 AUC.

deception_detection_andre_safety.verdict: All three SAE-family arms within 95% bootstrap CI of each other. The +0.28-0.30 white-box boost over text-only TF-IDF is the load-bearing finding.

deception_steering_andre_v2_fsga.method: FSGA / cFSGA — feature-space gated ablation, optionally probe-gated

cFSGA_capability_KL.note: Probe fires 0/200 on cap_alpaca → cFSGA is a literal no-op there

deception_steering_andre_v2_fsga.verdict: SAE T=1 dominates raw refusal-suppression magnitude (~10x larger). TXC has best leakage among T=5 family at K=20 (0.38 vs T-SAE 0.45). TXC scales monotonically with K; T-SAE saturates and then degrades. The cFSGA probe-gated protocol generalises across all three arms.

steering_c5_concept_steering.verdict: T-SAE wins on success-at-low-coherence (more steerable atoms); TXC has higher absolute coherence but lower success rate. TopK SAE struggles to produce coherent steering on this concept set.

alignment_em_nanda_qwen14b.verdict: Single-feature champion: SAE and TXC tied (~81 align). Bundle-k=3: SAE >> TXC (51.4 vs 33.3). Bundle-k=30: tied (~41.5). The k=30 ceiling is geometric (organism direction projection); the k=3 sub-axis is arch-specific (TXC top-3 anti-correlate, sum cancels).

alignment_em_qwen7b_medical.verdict: On bad-medical: SAE (Andy RDT, 131k dict) wins by +22 align. MLC trails by ~2 (+19.4). TXC trails by ~10 (+10.7). TXC's per-position decoder dilution + smaller dict are the most likely explanations.

reasoning_steering_aniket.tasks_500: 10 categories: math word problems, programming, sequences, probability, etc.
reasoning_steering_aniket.key_finding: Reasoning behaviors are mediated by linear directions (DoM/SAE/TXC) and steerable. TXC features competitive with SAE for behavior selection.
reasoning_steering_aniket.verdict: TXC features carry steerable reasoning-behavior signal; not a clear win or loss vs SAE in this regime — the paper-level claim is feasibility + interpretability of reasoning steering, not arch supremacy.

reasoning_backtracking_c7.task: Rescue truly-wrong DeepSeek reasoning trajectories via backtracking-direction steering, n=31
reasoning_backtracking_c7.verdict: Negative alpha (encourage backtracking) raises rescue rate over control by up to +6.5 pp on n=31 truly-wrong reasoning prompts. Effect is real but modest.

qualitative_autointerp_c4.verdict: T-SAE wins on autointerp judge-validated semantic top-N — consistent with T-SAE's per-position-localized features being easier for the LLM judge to label.

andre_safety_v1_60_prompt_steering_AUC.context: Top-10 decoder-direction ablation. T-SAE is the cleanest steering knob (AUC 0.95) with surgical refusal removal; TXC's diffuse subspace is easy to detect (H1) but hard to ablate via 10 directions; SAE's top-10 directions are anti-discriminative.

feature_geometry_andre.verdict: TXC decoder directions cluster much more strongly than SAE (top-2 clusters absorb 57% vs 12%), and cluster summaries are more temporally flavored. First direct evidence that TXC's temporal inductive bias shows in feature geometry.

training_efficiency.gemma_attn_layers_winner: TXCDR (lower FVU on mid_attn and final_attn)
training_efficiency.gemma_residual_layers_winner: Stacked SAE for mid_res; TXCDR for final_res
training_efficiency.verdict: TXC wins reconstruction on attention layers, loses on residual mid-layer, wins on final residual. SAE has lowest absolute FVU at matched compute on mid_res because k=100×T=1 has tighter bottleneck than 5×k=100.
